title: The Stablecoin Bridge bounty
description: "How Hashi meets the BCH BLAZE 2026 Stablecoin Bridge brief, line by line."

---

Hashi is built for the [BCH BLAZE 2026 Stablecoin Bridge](https://bchblaze.cash/bounties/stablecoin-bridge/) bounty.

| The brief asks | Hashi |
|---|---|
| "convert stablecoins on other chains to BCH stablecoins (eg USDC on ETH into PUSD on BCH)" | USDC and USDT on eight chains → PUSD or MUSD (or BCH). [Into Bitcoin Cash →](/docs/routes) |
| "And vice-versa, BCH stables to other-chain stables (eg PUSD on BCH into USDC on ETH)" | PUSD or MUSD (or BCH) → USDC or USDT on any of the eight chains |
| "from BCH stables to multiple/any other ecosystems would be even better" | Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain and Solana: EVM and non-EVM |
| "The faster, cheaper, and easier to use the bridge is - the better" | every route priced side by side, ranked by what you keep after gas; one screen; no account; no Hashi fee |
| "On the BCH side, WizardConnect is highly recommended" | the Bitcoin Cash wallet connects through [WizardConnect](/docs/bitcoin-cash/wizardconnect) |
| "On the other chain side, WalletConnect is probably essential" | EVM and Solana wallets through Reown AppKit (WalletConnect) |
| Stretch: "supporting multiple [BCH stablecoins] would be better" | PUSD and MUSD, plus PUSD ⇄ MUSD ⇄ BCH on Cauldron |
| Stretch: "route through large popular and existing multicoin providers like ShapeShift, ThorChain etc." | NEAR Intents and THORChain, priced side by side |
| "ParyonUSD … first priority integration & demo" | PUSD is the default: the swap card opens on USDC on Base → PUSD, and the landing's live sample is 100 USDC → PUSD |

Every flow above is built and priced live on mainnet; no swap has been run end to end with real money yet.
